core.note: The semantic planning core remains dependency-free and consumes injected adapters.

optional.name: oorexx-instrumentation-mesh
optional.purpose: estate-wide telemetry, freshness assessment and bounded operational events

optional.name: oorexx-intention-service
optional.purpose: language-facing UNKNOWN/CLARIFY/CONFIRM/READY state machine and dispatch gate

optional.name: job-node-allocator
optional.purpose: authoritative allocation plus observational runtime reconciliation; not linked by the planning core

optional.name: oorexx-ai-model-router
optional.purpose: non-entitling WLU/policy-backed LLM route selection projected into the GCI router assessment

optional.name: rexxos-rto2-grid
optional.purpose: current MU/MI estate membership and incarnation evidence; MI members may be projected as compute candidates but Grid does not grant placement or lease authority

pathRequirements.resolution: package src plus explicit Instrumentation Mesh dev8 src path
package src plus explicit Intention Service dev11 src path
package src plus explicit AI Model Router v0.1 src path; AI Model Router's own Alchemy Objects, WLU v0.12 and Institutional Policy v0.6 dependencies must also resolve
no RTO2 source is vendored or required by ::requires; the adapter consumes an injected current estate-controller object exposing estateMembers and optional estateSnapshot
